## Audit Report — M09 Task Coverage

I have completed a read-only audit of the תזכורת (reminder) entity addition to the tasks application. Here are my findings:

**One defect identified:**

```
new/dart-data-bs/auto/gen_app_tasks_ent2_content.dart:7 · empty-state text mismatch · P1 wrong result
```

The spec requires empty state text "אין תזכורות" (per line 9: `חלקיק תזכורת: [ריק] אין תזכורות`), but the generated code at `gen_app_tasks_ent2_c7` contains `'אין תזכורת עדיין — הרשומה הראשונה תופיע כאן'` instead.

**All other surfaces verified correct:**

- ✅ Entity definition: משימה* (required link), מועד* (required date), נשלחה (optional) — correctly indexed 0,1,2
- ✅ Cascade deletion: `registerRelation(..., policy=1)` in gen_app_tasks_relations.dart:6 wired correctly
- ✅ Table screen: ForgeDataGrid implementation at line 155 with all three columns and view toggles
- ✅ Validation: Required field checks at lines 46–47 prevent save without משימה and מועד
- ✅ Police report: All gates pass, both particles generated (ent2=1×, empty=data:px1)

The task is 80% complete (4 of 5 surfaces covered); the empty state text is the only gap.
